phase: Read-only SFC controller source and local artifact review
source_revision_vs_running_controller: Actual flashed images in the two physical controllers are not established by this source review.

current_feature.select_held_at_boot: Backspace usage 0x2a when held in all three startup samples
current_feature.startup_check: Three samples separated by 10 ms after the existing 20 ms reader settling wait, before UsbBackend::begin.
current_feature.boot_select_suppression: SELECT seen during boot is suppressed until released.

host_compatibility.scope: Input mapping difference applies after successful USB enumeration. It does not establish the cause of the earlier EP0 descriptor/address failures.

usb_review.scope: Source, manifest and build metadata inspected without executing project setup/build/upload scripts. Runtime packet timing and actual controller image remain unmeasured.

controller_flash_backup.tool_review: Available uiapflash help exposes upload/list/no-run, with no standalone flash-read command. No backup or controller write attempted.

next_decision: User authorized replacing the second-controller application with verified public v1.0.0; waiting for that controller to be connected to Mac in bootloader mode. Actual running controller image backup was not obtained.
privacy: Public repository identifiers, selected code behavior and artifact hashes only. User-supplied absolute source path, build/cache paths, raw USB/UART identifiers and unrelated files remain excluded.
